$comment: npm run models (or models:compress) publishes compressed models; raw assets untouched (tools/models/shrink-textures.mjs, fbx-mesh-to-glb.mjs). maxTextureSize: textures capped (the hub furniture packs embed the same 1024px gradient in every file). meshopt: geometry gently quantised and meshopt-compressed (decoded by core/three/GLTFLoaders.ts). fbxToGlb: mesh FBX (the character) published as a welded GLB, dropping fbxDropAttributes (the game swaps the material, so vertex colours are unused).
